0022600169.text: The Trail Blazers (3-1, second in the Northwest, half a game back) are 2-0 on the road and coming off a loss, while the Nuggets (3-2, fourth in the Northwest, one game back) have won their last two. Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Denver is without Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Trail Blazers lost the season series 1-3, including a 137-132 defeat in Denver in their last meeting.
